about: The Oracle's truths. One per flight, shuffled without repeats. 'deep' ones only come to flights that got very close to the sun. 'final' appears once all the others are learned, then the cycle restarts. Add more: give each a unique id.

truths.text: the sun was never hot. you were cold.
your father built the wings and the fall
everything you bought is still watching
the sky is a ceiling someone painted
the ads were always for you
the sea is where the sun goes to forget
you flew this before. you will again.
god is a billboard facing the other way
it does not get better. it gets brighter.
the answer is yes, and that is the problem
you were never high enough to see the edge

deep.text: you are the one who melts
